title: 選字異常與意外結束可匯出診斷
summary: 支援頁新增本機診斷匯出，協助定位選字、剪貼簿相容及意外結束問題。
highlights: 可記錄接下來兩分鐘的重現過程，並在儲存前檢視報告。
重新啟動時可查看上一次未正常結束的提示及可用的診斷。
usage: 開啟「設定 → 關於與支援 → 診斷與測試」。能重現時，先選「記錄接下來 2 分鐘」再重做操作。選「匯出診斷」檢視並儲存 JSON，依需要自行附到支援回報。

en.title: Export diagnostics for selection issues and unexpected exits
en.summary: Export a local report to help troubleshoot selection, clipboard compatibility, and unexpected exits.
highlights: Record up to two minutes while reproducing an issue, and review the report before saving.
After restarting, see an unexpected-exit notice and export any available details.
en.usage: Open Settings → About & Support → Diagnostics and tests. To reproduce an issue, select Record the next 2 minutes and repeat the steps. Select Export diagnostics to review and save the JSON file, then attach it to a support request if needed.
